Generate an ADRG Draft

Source: R/repro_indicators.R
adrg_skeleton.Rd

Writes a Markdown Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide following the standard PHUSE / R Consortium ADRG structure (sections 1 to 8 plus an R execution appendix), pre-filled by statically scanning the submission folder. From the scan it auto-fills the analysis datasets, the analysis output programs and their outputs, a program-to-output traceability table of the inputs each program reads, the proprietary and open-source R packages split with versions, the R version, and the execution steps. It also adds a Reproducibility and Verification section (environment, SAS vs R verification, clean-run evidence) that the base ADRG template omits. Sections needing human judgement are marked TODO. The draft contains every section assess_adrg() checks for.

Usage

adrg_skeleton(path = ".", out = NULL, config = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the submission's analysis code folder.

out

Output file. When NULL, writes ADRG.md inside path.

config

A configuration from repro_config_default().

Value

The path to the written file, invisibly.

Examples

d <- file.path(tempdir(), "sub_adrg")
dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines("x <- read.csv('data/adsl.csv')", file.path(d, "run.R"))
f <- adrg_skeleton(d)
#> ✔ Wrote ADRG draft to /tmp/RtmpKRiTPf/sub_adrg/ADRG.md
file.exists(f)
#> [1] TRUE
